steps.title: Three ideas
steps.body: The opening is the first few moves. Three simple principles help: control the centre, develop your knights and bishops, and castle to keep your king safe.

steps.title: Good development
steps.body: Both sides take the centre and bring out their knights. Each piece now has a useful square.

steps.question: Which one is a good opening principle?
options: Control the centre and develop pieces
steps.explanation: An early queen move lets the opponent gain time by attacking it with a developing move.
